`final class KeyLayout`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.input.key` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [KeyLayout.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/input/key/KeyLayout.java)

Translates the place of a letter or punctuation key into the key that the keyboard layout of the user types there.

## Description

A window library reports a key by its place on a US QWERTY keyboard: on a French AZERTY keyboard, the key that types `a` arrives as [`Key.Q`](/reference/input/key/#Key-value-Q).
A window bridge gives each key press two keys, its place and the key that the layout names; a `KeyLayout` computes the second from the first.
Only the letters `A` to `Z` and the punctuation keys from [`Key.APOSTROPHE`](/reference/input/key/#Key-value-APOSTROPHE) to [`Key.GRAVE_ACCENT`](/reference/input/key/#Key-value-GRAVE_ACCENT) depend on the layout; every other key passes through unchanged.

## Creation details

<a id="KeyLayout-factory-from"></a>

### from

`KeyLayout from(Function<Key,String> nameFunction)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates a layout from a function that returns the text that a place of the keyboard types with the current layout, such as the key name of the window library.
The function may return `null` when the place types nothing.

## Method details

<a id="KeyLayout-method-translate"></a>

### translate

`Key translate(Key key)` 

Returns the key that the layout types at a place.
The place comes back unchanged when it does not depend on the layout, or when the name function does not give one character that JOID knows.

<a id="KeyLayout-method-fromCharacter"></a>

### fromCharacter

`Key fromCharacter(char character)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns the letter or punctuation key that types a character, whatever its case, or `null` for any other character.

<a id="KeyLayout-method-isLayoutKey"></a>

### isLayoutKey

`boolean isLayoutKey(Key key)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns `true` for a key that depends on the layout: a letter or a punctuation key.
